provenance: Twelve real works selected by the project for a mechanism demo. Descriptions are brief original paraphrases of the linked Wikipedia articles, checked October 13, 2026. The selection emphasizes four themes and is not a representative test dataset. No lyrics, review labels or popularity measurements are included.

items.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
items.description: Scientists and astronauts travel to Jupiter to investigate an alien monolith, accompanied by the computer HAL.

items.title: Rendezvous with Rama
items.description: Human explorers intercept a huge alien spacecraft entering the Solar System and investigate its unfamiliar interior.

items.title: Space Oddity
items.description: David Bowie's song follows the fictional astronaut Major Tom, whose spacecraft loses contact with Ground Control.

items.title: Manchester by the Sea
items.description: Lee Chandler faces bereavement and responsibility for his nephew while struggling with enduring grief and guilt over his past.

items.title: A Grief Observed
items.description: C. S. Lewis reflects on mourning his wife Joy, describing life after her death and the questions it raises about faith.

items.title: Tears in Heaven
items.description: Eric Clapton wrote this song with Will Jennings while grieving the death of his young son Conor.

items.title: V for Vendetta
items.description: A masked rebel attempts to inspire a revolution against the totalitarian government controlling Britain.

items.title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
items.description: Winston Smith secretly opposes the ruling Party while living under pervasive surveillance and the manipulation of historical truth.

items.title: Get Up, Stand Up
items.description: This Wailers song has accompanied human-rights concerts and performances supporting political protesters.

items.title: Stand by Me
items.description: Four boys journey to find a missing boy's body. Their friendship helps Gordie confront his insecurity and family troubles.

items.title: Charlotte's Web
items.description: Wilbur, a pig, develops a friendship with Charlotte, a spider who works to save him from slaughter.

items.title: You've Got a Friend
items.description: Carole King's song, also recorded by James Taylor, centers on friendship and being there for another person.
